name: NoticeClock
short: Assess a contractual notice and cure record against frozen terms using independent semantic consensus, with an explicit inconclusive outcome.
problem: Parties disagree over whether a notice identifies an applicable breach and states a sufficiently clear cure.
solution: Freezes the clause and designated third-party attestor before evidence is locked, then classifies breach, applicability and cure specificity with bounded independent validator evaluation.
outcomes: READY, INVALID, or INCONCLUSIVE. A final verdict is recorded only after the challenge window or a second round.
productionQualification: INCOMPLETE: public app remains RELEASE_QUALIFIED=false pending signed-browser live E2E; do not submit as a fully qualified frontend.
